title: Shorthanded Pacers hold off Knicks in NBA Cup thriller
summary: The injury-hit Indiana Pacers held off the New York Knicks 106-104 on Friday, thwarting a Knicks comeback bid to leave New York's bid for an NBA Cup repeat in tatters.
